verdict: No paid activity this period; organic reach is declining and needs attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, leaving your Google Business Profile as the only active channel — it delivered 51 total actions including 2 calls, 37 direction requests, and 12 website clicks. That profile activity dropped 54% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7, with the last 3 days recording zero actions, a confirmed acceleration of the decline. Search clicks fell 53% over the same window, pointing to a shared loss of organic visibility rather than an isolated issue. We are investigating the visibility drop now and will have a clearer picture — and a plan to stabilize it — by next week's report.
